commons.title: Kahungunu.jpg
commons.description: Carving representing Kahungunu, ancestor of the Māori tribe Ngāti Kahungunu. From the canoe house at Waitangi Treaty Grounds, Waitangi, Bay of Islands, New Zealand. Kahungunu is depicted holding a hoe, a canoe paddle, signifying his prowess and exploits as a navigator.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption specifically identifies the carving as Kahungunu, ancestor of Ngāti Kahungunu, and the image visibly shows a traditional Māori carved cultural object.
